title: Hosted API pricing — monthly token estimate & peak TPS confirmation
text:
Hosted API pricing — monthly token estimate & peak TPS confirmation

['From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.ai>\\nCc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, ethan.park@redwood.ai\\nDate: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800\\nSubject: Post-call recap: hosted API pricing inputs we discussed\\n\\nJordan — thanks again for the quick call today. Short recap and a couple of clarifying asks so we can produce an apples-to-apples hosted estimate: \\n\\nSummary of what I heard from your team:\\n- Primary use: customer-facing assistant (search + summarization + light generation) across web and mobile.\\n- Expected first-year ramp: pilots in Q2, GA in Q4.\\n- Latency sensitivity: 95th %ile <= 400ms for chat flows.\\n\\nInfo we need to finalize a hosted pricing proposal (please confirm):\\n1) Expected monthly token volume (approx range ok) — examples: 10M / 50M / 200M tokens.\\n2) Peak TPS (tokens/s) during busy periods and sustained TPS target (e.g., 30s bursts vs sustained 5 TPS).\\n3) Target unit economics — is there a target $/1M tokens you need us to hit for budget approvals?\\n4) Any hard budget range for P0 (pilot) and P1 (GA).\\n\\nAction items we’ll take once we have those numbers:\\n- Attach a lightweight cost model (MVP_pricing_model.xlsx) showing tiered pricing assumptions and impact of batching/quantization.\\n- Provide two scenarios: hosted standard SLO and low-latency premium (smaller batch windows).\\n- Draft SOW and procurement checklist for your finance team.\\n\\nIf it helps, Ben can do a short call with procurement to walk through payment terms and PO flow. Ethan will map the TPS numbers to instance sizing and warm pool behavior.\\n\\nThanks — if you can reply with the ranges later today/tomorrow that would be great.\\n\\n— Mina\\nMina Haddad\\nEnterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference\\nmina.haddad@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182\\n\\n[Attachment: MVP_pricing_model.xlsx]', "From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.ai>\\nTo: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>\\nCc: Asha Raman <asha.raman@acme.ai>\\nDate: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 17:03:00 -0800\\nSubject: Re: Post-call recap: hosted API pricing inputs we discussed\\n\\nThanks Mina — appreciate the tidy recap. Answers below (high level, will confirm with eng/procurement tomorrow):\\n\\n1) Monthly token volume (estimate):\\n- Pilot (Q2): 20M–40M tokens/month.\\n- Ramp (Q3): 80M–150M tokens/month.\\n- GA (Q4+): planning for 200M–350M tokens/month depending on adoption.\\n\\n2) Peak TPS:\\n- Typical peak (concurrent user surge): ~35–45 TPS observed during internal load tests.\\n- Sustained baseline TPS: ~6–8 TPS (steady daytime traffic).\\n- Spiky events: short bursts up to ~80 TPS for 2–3 minutes during product launches (we'd expect fallback behavior).\\n\\n3) Target unit economics:\\n- For budget board approval we’re aiming for sub-$350 per 1M tokens on hosted. For GA scale, finance would like to see options down to ~$250/1M if we commit to volume.\\n\\n4) Budget ranges:\\n- Pilot: $6k–$12k/month (OPEX).\\n- GA initial run: $40k–$120k/month depending on adoption.\\n\\nWe’ll float a formal procurement timeline tomorrow — Asha is looped for procurement/PO details.\\n\\n—Jordan", 'From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.ai>\\nCc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, ben.carter@redwood.ai\\nDate: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800\\nSubject: Quick sizing + unit-econ scenarios (attached model)\\n\\nJordan — thanks for the ranges. I attached a simple workbook (MVP_pricing_model.xlsx) but called out the key buckets here so you can see the levers: \\n\\nAssumptions used: avg tokens per request = 400 tokens (range 200–800), model = open-llama-70B-quant (example), warm pool target = 2x baseline concurrency.\\n\\nScenario A — Low-latency (smaller batches):\\n- 200M tokens/month → effective throughput need ≈ 77 TPS avg, peak 45–80 TPS\\n- Estimated hosted list price (no commit): ~$420 / 1M tokens\\n- With 12-month volume commitment & batching/quantization optimizations: ~$300 / 1M tokens\\n\\nScenario B — Cost-first (aggressive batching & heavier quant):\\n- 200M tokens/month → same token count but higher batching → lower instance counts\\n- Estimated: ~$240–270 / 1M tokens with a 12-month commit and warm pool tuning\\n\\nNotes on peak TPS and warm pools:\\n- For short bursts (<= 3 minutes) we rely on burst capacity; sustained high TPS requires reserved capacity to keep cold-starts minimal.\\n- If you need 95th %ile latency <= 400ms we recommend a small warm pool and lower batch window which increases per-token cost ~10–20% vs cost-first scenario.\\n\\nNext steps we suggest:\\n- Confirm token distribution (avg tokens per call) so we can iterate the workbook.\\n- If finance has a target like $250/1M for GA, we can model a 12–18 month commit + modest discount banding.\\n\\n— Ethan Park\\nSolutions Engineer | Redwood Inference\\nethan.park@redwood.ai\\n\\n[Attachment: MVP_pricing_model.xlsx]', 'From: procurement@acme.ai <procurement@acme.ai>\\nTo: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.ai>\\nDate: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 15:40:00 -0800\\nSubject: Acme AI — budget confirmation & PO process\\n\\nHi Mina / Jordan — following up from internal ops call. Procurement notes below: \\n\\n- Budget range for vendor selection: $50k–$100k/month for first 6 months of GA. This includes both hosting and integration support.\\n- We require vendor to accept a standard PO + 30 net payment terms for pilot; for GA we may move to a quarterly invoice cadence.\\n- Please attach your standard SOW template and our PO template (attached) so legal can review ahead of time.\\n\\nTimeline: we expect procurement review completed by March 12 and a signed PO by March 25 if terms align.\\n\\nRegards,\\nAcme Procurement Team\\n[Attachment: Acme_PO_template.docx]', 'From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.ai>, procurement@acme.ai\\nCc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, ethan.park@redwood.ai\\nDate: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:45:00 -0800\\nSubject: Re: Hosted API pricing — monthly token estimate & peak TPS confirmation\\n\\nGreat — thanks everyone for the fast responses and the procurement outline. Quick summary and next steps from our side: \\n\\nSummary:\\n- Token ranges: Pilot 20–40M / Ramp 80–150M / GA 200–350M tokens/month (confirmed).\\n- Peak TPS: baseline 6–8 TPS, typical peaks ~35–45 TPS, short bursts up to ~80 TPS.\\n- Target unit economics: finance target ~<$350/1M; stretch to ~$250/1M with volume commit.\\n- Procurement: target PO signed by 2026-03-25 (noted).\\n\\nRedwood next steps (owned):\\n1) Share two pricing scenarios (pilot and GA) with expected $/1M tokens and impact of warm pool sizing — attached SOW draft + pricing workbook. (Mina)\\n2) Ben will schedule a 30-minute procurement walk-through with Acme procurement/legal next week. (Ben)\\n3) Ethan to prepare a short notes doc mapping warm pool sizing to 95th %ile latency for the expected TPS ranges. (Ethan)\\n\\nPlease find attached the draft SOW (SOW_draft_v1.pdf) and the pricing model. I’ll also create a short HubSpot deal note and attach the DocuSign SOW link once the procurement call confirms recipients.\\n\\nCan we tentatively schedule the procurement walk-through for next Wed (2026-02-25) at 10:00 AM PT? Ben — can you send a calendar invite?\\n\\nThanks — looking forward to moving this to pilot.\\n\\n— Mina\\nMina Haddad\\nEnterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference\\nmina.haddad@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182\\n\\n[Attachments: SOW_draft_v1.pdf, MVP_pricing_model.xlsx]']
